topic.title: Turtle Race
topic.description: A turtle racing game where the user bets on a color and multiple turtles race across the screen with random step sizes. Introduces multiple turtle objects.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Creating and positioning multiple Turtle objects, using screen.textinput() for user input, and detecting a winner by x-position.
learningNotes.challenges: Setting up initial positions for each turtle and determining which reached the finish line first.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add lap counting, obstacles, and an animated scoreboard.

files.description: Color betting turtle race with random movement.
